questions.subject: Pharmacology
questions.question: Drug of choice for anaphylactic shock is:
questions.explanation: Intramuscular adrenaline is the first-line treatment of anaphylaxis.

questions.subject: Physiology
questions.question: Normal adult resting heart rate (beats per minute) is:
questions.explanation: A resting rate of 60–100 per minute is normal in adults.

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.question: The largest bone of the human body is:
questions.explanation: The femur is the longest and strongest bone.
